rationale: Two NOVELTY findings are FPs from the filename::url source-array extraction bug; R054 fires on a standard systemd user service install; H015/H020 are informational. Net benign.

evidence.R054: Standard systemd user service install into $pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/user/; legitimate for a portal backend.
evidence.NOVELTY: Source URL is present as filename::url in the source array; extract_urls_from_diff does not strip the filename:: prefix.

code_fixes.diff:
--- a/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
+++ b/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
@@ -97,3 +97,6 @@
 def extract_urls_from_diff(diff_text: str) -> SourceChanges:
     """Extract added and removed URLs from a diff."""
+    # filename:: prefixes in source array entries are AUR labels, not
+    # part of the URL; strip them before novelty comparison so a renamed
+    # label does not read as a new upstream.
     added_urls: set[str] = set()
code_fixes.summary: strip filename:: label before URL novelty comparison
